convention: One XD per commander record answered. Units on the page open + and the commander flips them to -; approval is full, part or held; a full decision is frozen and the pilot proceeds. Numbering is global and never reused.

units.summary: The order the four migration orders run in: constitution first, then orders and advice together, then decisions; one dossier at the end.
Migrating the Or records into CO from the transcripts; no old ids; retired orders to orders/retired/.
The old CA files become CR-001 to CR-005; their advice extracted into units with a manifest each.
Extracting the constitution into records and settling the twelve record schemas, the lint and the prefix glossary.
Distributing the De records into CO and CA from the transcripts, pruning the rest, sweeping old citations.
Collecting the cockpit's terms from dispatches, rosters and crew files into base/GLOSSARY.md with - bullets for the commander to flip.

units.name: truth suite
units.summary: Settling the truth suite's shape: four advice statements (three truth rooms, check files as JSON, the workshop directory, advice imported in the workshop and truth locked at build), the eight records moved to concepts, first check files, the advocate's check.

units.name: pilot tools
units.summary: The pilot reads, writes, edits, greps and globs; grep for discovery not bulk; shell, count and lint are clerk tasks; bash denied by machinery; claude -p only once granted back.

units.name: one decision each
units.summary: One decision per commander record; split pages for several; the schema enforces one answers id; an order is answered when the pilot acts on it. The answered_by sweep unit was struck.

units.name: no residue
units.summary: No old ids on migrated records; old directories deleted after run 3; pre-dash files renamed with a name in the rooms refactor; settled and retired directories; old prefixes absent from the glossary.

units.name: disputes name records
units.summary: Every dispute names the extracted records on each side; the two self-contradicting records named twice; lines and binds as their own units; closing a dispute syncs it with the commander's changes.

units.name: rooms refactor
units.summary: Move the cockpit's rooms to CA-042's layout after run 3, by a clerk from a path map with the advocate sweeping the diff; manuals sorted, notepad nested by mission, the desk folded into records/pilot.

units.name: decision audit
units.summary: The commanders-advocate audits every decision against the commander's records; faulted decisions are redrafted; the audit repeats before any batch goes for approval.
